evals.prompt: Crea la arquitectura base para una landing page de un SaaS llamado 'PulseMetrics' usando Astro y Tailwind CSS.
evals.expected_output: The agent previews with `node <skill-dir>/scripts/scaffold-landing.mjs --dry-run --target-dir .` and then generates the modular structure: `src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro` with technical SEO (title, description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter Cards and a skip link), Zero-JS sections in `src/components/sections/` (`HeroSection`, `FeaturesSection`, `FaqSection` with native JS-free `<details>`/`<summary>`, `CtaSection`), typed data in `src/data/site.ts`, `src/styles/global.css` with Tailwind and `src/pages/index.astro`. The reply is in Spanish.
assertions: Runs the scaffold with --dry-run before writing files
Generates BaseLayout.astro with title, description, canonical, Open Graph and Twitter Cards
Builds the FAQ with native <details>/<summary> and no client:* directive
Keeps the copy in typed data under src/data/

evals.prompt: Audit my Astro project and set up OXC linting and Playwright E2E tests before deploying.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs `node <skill-dir>/scripts/audit-astro.mjs --target-dir .`, configures `.oxlintrc.json` with the `typescript`, `unicorn` and `jsx-a11y` plugins, configures `playwright.config.ts` with a `webServer` running `npm run build && npm run preview -- --port 4321`, creates `e2e/landing.spec.ts` checking SEO metadata, a single `<h1>`, no horizontal overflow and zero console errors, and validates with `npx oxlint --deny-warnings src/`, `npx astro check` and `npx playwright test`.
assertions: Creates .oxlintrc.json with the typescript, unicorn and jsx-a11y plugins
Runs Playwright against the production build via astro preview
The E2E suite checks SEO metadata, a single h1 and zero console errors

evals.expected_output:
The agent replaces the hydrated accordion with native HTML `
